column1: # Programme PDFs published on a conference's own website.
# IEEE does not index a front-matter programme for every year - 14 conference
# years in this corpus have none at all in Xplore. The conference itself
# usually still publishes one, and it is often better than IEEE's: the VLSI
# Symposium's own programme codes its sessions C1../T1.., which separates the
# Circuits and Technology tracks structurally instead of by a hand-built list.
# The PDF is fetched once and cached at cache/<conference>/toc/<year>-web.pdf,
# then treated as another programme candidate - it still has to beat whatever
# grouping the year already has, so adding a bad URL cannot damage a good year.
# HTML-only programmes. A line may list several comma-separated pages when
# the conference splits its programme across them.
# A-SSCC 2024: the conference's own session pages (epapers2.org), session_id 1..29.
# A-SSCC 2007: advance programme PDF on the conference host (VDEC, Univ. of Tokyo); IEEE indexes no 2007 programme.
